teaser.en: Its timber shrugs off seawater, so it went into dhows, piers and mallets; its name means 'across the river'.
teaser.sw: Mbao zake hazidhuriwi na maji ya bahari, hivyo zilitumika kwa majahazi, gati na nyundo za mbao; jina lake lina maana ya 'ng'ambo ya mto'.
teaser.dg: Nyama za muhi uhu tazibanangika ni madzi ga bahari, ndiyo mana zahumirwa kuhenda majahazi, magati na gongomeha za mbao; dzinare rina mana ya 'ng'ambo ya muho'.

summary.en: *Mng'ambo* is a tall evergreen tree of lowland forest and bushland with rough dark bark and white latex. Its strong, seawater-resistant timber was used for dhows and piers, and its milky sweet fruit is eaten.
summary.sw: *Mng'ambo* ni mti mrefu wa kijani kibichi wa misitu ya nyanda za chini na vichaka, wenye gome jeusi lililokwaruza na utomvu mweupe. Mbao zake imara zisizodhuriwa na maji ya bahari zilitumika kwa majahazi na gati, na tunda lake tamu lenye utomvu kama maziwa huliwa.
summary.dg: *Mng'ambo* ni muhi mure wenye makodza chila wakati, wa matsaka ga tsi za photsi na vitsaka, wenye gopha ra rangi ya jiza rinarokaraza na maziya mereru. Nyama za muhi ni ngumu na tazibanangika ni madzi ga bahari, kpwa hivyo zahumirwa kuhenda majahazi na magati, na tunda renye maziya na ra mtswano nkuriwa.

about.en: *Mng'ambo* is an evergreen tree up to 25 metres tall. The bark is rough and dark, and it bleeds white latex. The leaves are stiff and oblong, clustered at the ends of the twigs, and their side veins run very close and parallel.
about.sw: *Mng'ambo* ni mti wa kijani kibichi unaofikia urefu wa mita 25. Gome lake ni jeusi na lililokwaruza, na hutoa utomvu mweupe. Majani yake ni magumu na marefu kiasi, yamejikusanya kwenye ncha za vitawi, na mishipa yake ya pembeni inakwenda sambamba ikiwa karibu sana.
about.dg: *Mng'ambo* ni muhi wenye makodza chila wakati wa hadi mita 25. Gopha rinakaraza na ni ra rangi ya jiza, na rinalavya maziya mereru. Makodza ni magumu na mare, ganakala phamwenga kpwenye ntsa za maphungo, na mishipa yao ya kanda-kanda inaphiya phephi sana na sawa-sawa.

where.en: It grows in lowland forest and coastal bushland, and Pakia notes that it grows on riverbanks.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya nyanda za chini na vichaka vya pwani, na Pakia anabainisha kuwa hukua kwenye kingo za mito.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga tsi za photsi na vitsaka vya pwani, na Pakia anagomba kukala unamera kanda-kanda ya miho.

uses.en:
The timber is strong and resists seawater, so it is used for dhows, piers and mallets.

The fruit is milky and sweet, and it is eaten. The bark and roots are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw:
Mbao zake ni imara na hazidhuriwi na maji ya bahari, hivyo hutumika kwa majahazi, gati na nyundo za mbao.

Tunda lake lina utomvu kama maziwa na ni tamu, na huliwa. Gome na mizizi hutumika katika dawa za jadi.
uses.dg:
Nyama za muhi ni ngumu na tazibanangika ni madzi ga bahari, kpwa hivyo nkuhumirwa kuhenda majahazi, magati na gongomeha za mbao.

Tunda rina maziya na ni ra mtswano, na nkuriwa. Gopha na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa ya chienyeji.

names.en: The ICRAF handbook gives the Digo name *mng'ambo* (also *mungambo*). Pakia uses *mng'ambo* for a related species, *Manilkara discolor*, and explains the name as 'across the river', because it grows on riverbanks. In Swahili it is *mngambo* or *mti chuma*, 'iron tree'. The Giriama name is *mng'ambo maziya* and the Chonyi *mngambo*.
names.sw: Kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa jina la Kidigo *mng'ambo* (pia *mungambo*). Pakia anatumia *mng'ambo* kwa spishi nyingine ya jamii yake, *Manilkara discolor*, na anaeleza kuwa jina hili lina maana ya 'ng'ambo ya mto', kwa sababu hukua kwenye kingo za mito. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mngambo* au *mti chuma*, 'mti wa chuma'. Jina la Kigiriama ni *mng'ambo maziya* na la Kichonyi *mngambo*.
names.dg: Chitabu cha ICRAF chinapha dzina ra Chidigo *mng'ambo* (piya *mungambo*). Pakia anahumira *mng'ambo* kpwa aina yanjina iriyo ndugu, *Manilkara discolor*, na anagomba kukala dzina rina mana ya 'ng'ambo ya muho', kpwa sababu unamera kanda-kanda ya miho. Kpwa Chiswahili unaihwa *mngambo* au *mti chuma*, 'muhi wa chuma'. Dzina ra Chigiryama ni *mng'ambo maziya* na ra Chichonyi ni *mngambo*.
